def test_fsid_url(erepo_dir):
    from dvc.repo import Repo

    url = f"file://{erepo_dir.as_posix()}"

        fs = DVCFileSystem(repo=dvc)
        assert fs.fsid == "dvcfs_" + tokenize(url, erepo_dir.scm.get_rev())
        old_fsid = fs.fsid

    with erepo_dir.chdir():
        erepo_dir.dvc_gen({"foo": "foo"}, commit="foo")

    with Repo.open(url) as dvc:
        fs = DVCFileSystem(repo=dvc)
        assert fs.fsid != old_fsid
        assert fs.fsid == "dvcfs_" + tokenize(url, erepo_dir.scm.get_rev())

def test_init_with_url_kwarg_deprecated(tmp_dir, dvc):
    tmp_dir.gen("foo", "foo")
    dvc.add("foo")
    (tmp_dir / "foo").unlink()

    with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning, match="use 'repo' instead"):
        fs = DVCFileSystem(url=str(tmp_dir))
    assert fs.exists("foo")

    with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning, match="use 'repo' instead"):
        fs = DVCFileSystem(url=tmp_dir)
    assert fs.exists("foo")

    with pytest.warns(DeprecationWarning, match="use 'repo' instead"):
        fs = DVCFileSystem(url=dvc)
    assert fs.exists("foo")


def test_init_with_repo_path(tmp_dir, dvc):
    tmp_dir.gen("foo", "foo")
    dvc.add("foo")
    (tmp_dir / "foo").unlink()

    fs = DVCFileSystem(repo=str(tmp_dir))
    assert fs.exists("foo")

    fs = DVCFileSystem(repo=tmp_dir)
    assert fs.exists("foo")
